@thomas_wazzaGood question, that's exactly where a lot of timers break. The Pomodoro widget saves its state every few seconds, so closing the tab by mistake doesn't lose your session: open a new tab and it carries on from where you left off.  
  
One honest caveat: it doesn't count down while no BaseTab tab is open, so the minutes it was closed aren't subtracted, and the end chime only plays in an open tab. Turning it into a true background timer with a notification when it ends is next on my list.

results.content:
basetab.ai – Your Browser's New Home Turn every new tab into a fully customizable productivity dashboard. basetab.ai replaces your browser's default new tab page with a powerful, widget-based workspace where you can organize everything you need — bookmarks, notes, tasks, AI assistants, file storage, integrations, and more — all in one place. Why basetab.ai? Every time you open a new tab, you're greeted with the same blank page or a list of frequently visited sites. basetab.ai transforms that wasted space into a personal command center. No more switching between apps, tabs, or windows to check your calendar, manage your to-dos, chat with AI, or jot down a quick note. Everything lives right where you start — your new tab. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🧩 32 Built-in Widgets basetab.ai [...] who want a centralized dashboard for daily work • Students managing assignments, schedules, and study notes • Developers who want GitHub stats, code notes, and AI assistants at a glance • Remote workers coordinating across timezones and calendars • Traders and investors tracking crypto, forex, and commodity prices • Content creators managing media, embeds, and creative tools • Productivity enthusiasts who love customizing their workflow • Teams collaborating on shared dashboards and project boards • Anyone tired of a boring, empty new tab page Get Started in Seconds Install the extension, open a new tab, and start adding widgets.
